job.name: s6_first
job.prompt: The pharmacist from the photo reference (same face, hair, white coat) stands behind a pharmacy counter, has just raised her eyes from the counter and warmly greets a customer who is just approaching, making eye contact and smiling first, before the customer has said anything. Walls and shelves have NO signs, posters or labels at all — shelves hold plain colored boxes without any markings.
job.meaning: фармацевт первой поднимает взгляд и здоровается, раньше чем посетитель начал говорить
